notes: This heading organises references; it is not an additional physical menu.
Next Option confirms zone/pair/output choices; Sounder Status toggles directly.
The one-man walk-test sounding cadence is approximately one second on/eight seconds off. Indicator descriptions differ between pages 15 and 17.

numbering.explanation: These are documented physical controls, indications and engineering functions. They are not LCD menu screens. Displayed configuration codes retain the manual’s exact spelling. SW8 follows the recorded S-shaped function sequence. No LCD menu numbers are assigned.
caveats: The trainer retains only choices confirmed with Next Option. The engineering pages specify confirmation but do not explicitly describe every exit/wrap edge case.
The one-man walk-test sounding cadence is approximately one second on/eight seconds off. Indicator descriptions differ between pages 15 and 17.

navigation.action: Enter/advance the documented internal engineering function sequence.
Toggle the selected documented item; verify confirmation and restoration.

coverage.strategy: Derived from FINDR’s existing reviewed manufacturer sources; references, supported simulation and authored practice tasks remain distinct.
mappedAreas: Documented physical keys, indications and internal controls.
Source-backed operator functions and all existing guided lessons.
All nine SW8 function positions, with programming and diagnostic views kept distinct.
excludedAreas: A fictional eight-zone CFP Standard training configuration, not an electrical panel model or a live system connection.
The removable-cover view represents the Main Control PCB documented in Figure 12; it does not invent a full power-supply or mains interior.
The manual marks coincidence and non-latching operation as non-compliant with EN54-2. Their presence in the trainer is not approval for an installation.
Only the documented configuration relationships are represented. Coupled edge cases, electrical thresholds, detector protocols and analogue circuit behaviour are outside the simulation.

Test timing is an approximate training-clock demonstration. Page 15 describes pulsing Test/zone indicators while page 17 describes them as steady after leaving programming; that source difference is retained rather than treated as a universal firmware timing specification.
Closing the training cover does not press Escape Access or change stored engineering settings. Any simulator draft handling is distinct from a verified lid sensor or firmware behaviour.
This is the Standard fascia/edition. Similar Economy or AlarmSense cabinets do not establish compatibility.
coverage.confidence: Manual-backed reference; not hardware or firmware certification.
